recent.author: Mike Morreale

recent.text: Hellebuyck on the GWG said he thought he had it... and then, stopped himself and added: "I guess 99% of it." Went on to add: "Just bounced off my glove, off my arm, and squeaked through. Those are the ones of the goalie you hate, and they feel horrible, but you just got to shake
recent.author: Amanda Stein

recent.text: #NJDevils HC Keefe didn't want to make too big of a deal of this one loss, and rightfully so, especially given how the team has played and been able to bounce back: "Anytime you lose, you're going to overanalyze every little thing. There's lots of things we need to do better.
recent.author: Amanda Stein

recent.text: Timo Meier on tonights #NJDevils loss: "We made too many mistakes. We didn't play our hockey for long enough. We need to get back to our brand. We've showed that we can have success with that. So yeah, it's a one-off, and now we got to move on and then get ready for the next
recent.author: Amanda Stein

recent.text: Just one of those nights... not going to win them all. #NJDevils HC Keefe: "They're plus one on special teams. Helle made a number of great saves. Their guy made a number of great saves. So, it's just one of those nights."
recent.author: Amanda Stein
